description: Monthly counts of what AI agents can do at the websites this network checked, by country, kind of business, platform, source or city; counts only, no business named. Without edition, the latest. Open data under CC BY 4.0: credit "Surfing Dog census, surfingdog.ai, CC BY 4.0", and "© Overture Maps Foundation" with city and country counts.

edition.description: The month, YYYY-MM. Without it, the latest published edition.

key.description: One key of the scope: a country code (GB), a group slug, a platform slug, a source, or a city slug (madrid). Without it, every key of the scope with its headline counts.

scope.description: all (the default), country, group (kind of business), platform, source (where the sites came from) or city.

name: get_census

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
